name: Apigee Extras
description: Provides extended functionality for the Apigee Edge (API management/developer portal) integration.
project_description:
Enhances the Apigee integration by providing extended developer portal utilities. Works with Apigee X and Apige Edge.

 Modules 
 Views integration , allowing site builders to create complex, filtered lists of Apigee Applications, API Products, and Developer metadata directly through the Drupal UI.

 Bootstrap 5 library integration making it out of the box bootstrap compatible with themes like bootstrap5 .
